verdict.rationale: Supermemory is not itself an agent but a memory service, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair axis; docs confirm a Supermemory MCP server that gives 'every MCP-compatible assistant a shared memory layer' with natural-language tool selection, plus a separate docs-search MCP for integration, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation of the MCP server working end-to-end with a real agent, and no explicit setup/connection instructions cited in the pack.
